notes.title: Minor keeper update #3
notes.content: Increased the chance of keeper catching the ball rather than parry.

notes.title: Minor keeper update #2
notes.content:
- Keeper parry angle adjusted. This to significantly reduce the chances that a save still turn into a goal.
 - Keeper parry are slower.

notes.title: Minor keeper update
notes.content:
Some changes on the keepers:


 Keeper lose some reach. So they can't dive from center of goal to the post but just a bit short of it.
 Keeper do gain a lot more diving speed. So while losing some range, they get there a lot quicker.
 Keeper diving frame rates has been increased. So the animation will not feel 'cut off' as it was the case years ago. This is actually very important.
 Keeper will catch less shots than before.


That's it. Bigger updates will come. Also if you have any suggestion, whether it's gameplay, assets or anything. Just post it in #feedback in our Discord channel!

notes.title: IOSoccer Hub Launched
notes.content:
A long time in the making, the IOSoccer Hub is here! The Hub forms part of our brand new website, and will be the home of all things IOS. The Hub integrates seamlessly with the existing matchmaking experience, providing all of the following features:


 Check up on match results for all matches - friendly, competitive, or anywhere in-between, including a match overview page for each match, with detailed stats
 View & compare statistics of all players & teams within the community
 Individual profiles for every player & team, featuring in-depth graphs, and all the statistics that you could ask for
 Manage your team, whether it be adding players to your squad, or configuring CoachBot integration for matchmaking
 Compete with other players in the community on the new Fantasy game
 Show off your clairvoyant skills with the new Score Predictor game
 Follow tournaments, with current standings, statistics, fixtures. During the beta phase, management of tournaments will be restricted to IOSF, however this will open this up to all tournament organisers soon.


Keep reading for a preview of all areas of the Hub. Please note that the Hub is currently in beta for Europe, however will be rolled out to other communities shortly.

If you wanna dive right in, head on over to https://www.iosoccer.com

New Official Website
The hub forms part of the new official IOSoccer website, and holds lots of useful information, such as various manuals (player, server, bot, etc).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/924d67c7ea19281e04596465d742fa3a865fab72.png

Results
View the latest results at a glance for all teams, for both competitive and friendly games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/bc4d68804c587fdb35001962b03766681c0766ce.png

Fixtures
View upcoming fixtures, across all current tournaments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/d8232d75375f62063935d488ca4e0ce90cc1f6c2.png

Match Overviews
The match overview page is available as soon as the final whistle has been blown. You can immediately view the result, as well as team lineups, match events, visual team stats, and in-depth player statistics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/53a7ed17b7fe7ef99a57d80b0a1c0661b3fcb9af.png

Player Profiles
View a players team history, their recent matches, how they’ve fared in tournaments, and in-depth player statistics, including a number of graphs, and a heatmap showing the player’s playing activity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/590f623eed0f8a0bc29260cdf19f2fd5f657e7c6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/0d57a7e07b7a1d6cc6d6e8261b9ff65a0165a005.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/71e27e0ee0299cde1defa3248eaf0fe9fa3b7540.png

Team Profiles
Much like the player profile, the team profile page includes in-depth history, covering both results and also players, as well as a wealth of statistics, and their recent form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/b752dac2e682f9d6185d75ee19402459d77f8c8a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/4e5377e263149393738d344de20f488a70b36dc5.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/be205ea27883b801dc3f74bcbac99f255d857a3c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/49bed51a6bd39abeff828e3c0f6873682d78b44e.png

Team Management
The team management feature allows you to manage your squad, which will be used in tournaments, and also configure your team’s CoachBot integration for matchmaking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/4c446fb84a5053bc855e71445df92c8906f5a5ef.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/fe815b63a6a7f88cec5aa090a5b1c5f5828ce654.png

Tournaments
All tournaments will now be trackable, featuring up-to-date standings, results, fixtures, all in one place. The Hub will receive match data at the final whistle, and automatically update results, as well as current standings. For cup competitions will also generate the next fixtures automatically on-the-fly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/75fb4620fd957eaf8e1a3702404b5300a52e1bb9.png

Fantasy Game
For all tournaments on the hub, you can enter a fantasy team, picking the players you think that will lead your team to victory, in competition with other players on the Hub. Once you pick your team, you can track your players game-by-game, with scores updating immediately after each match ends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32794956/c542e3c063582908ae3789386c5d0483a3ed4815.png

Score Predictor
The score predictor game allows you to log your predictions for all to see, as you compete against others on the Hub, both on a tournament-by-tournament basis, but also on the global all-time leaderboard.

notes.title: Charge update
notes.content:
To stimulate action and make the game more fun we've decided to reduce the charge duration to 0.75s.


Charging
 Charging a shot 100% takes now 0.75s. (was 1s)
 Charge continues to de-charge if you keep holding it. The duration from 100% to 0% takes 1.5s.
 The charge will stay frozen for 0.25s when reaching 100% before it goes down. (was 0.5s and would reset after)
 When you release charge at anytime it will idle for 0.25s before it starts de-charging.

Slide tackle
As requested
 Slide tackle front reach has been reduced
 Slide tackle idle duration is heavily reduced, which means you get up quicker

Keeper
Keeper mechanics needed some tweaking due to the charge changes, as per the following:
 Keeper gets up quicker after a dive
 Keeper diving duration time decreased
 Keeper diving speed increased
 Keeper diving height reach increased when performing side and backward dive


Upcoming updates will be more focused outside of gameplay. So things like mapping, kits, animations etc. Suggestions are always welcome though!

notes.title: Further spectator mode camera changes.
notes.content:
Following on from the earlier update today around spectator cameras - the ability to zoom in and out whilst in spectator mode now also includes the following TV Cameras:

 Sideline
 Fixed Sideline
 Fly Follow
 Top Down


The following client convars are also now available for manual tweaking, however, as with other spec cameras, can be manipulated via cl_spec_cam_increase_dist and cl_spec_cam_decrease_dist,  which is bound to your mouse's scrollwheel by default, whilst in that particular camera mode.

 cl_tvcam_sideline_offset_height
 cl_tvcam_sideline_offset_top
  cl_tvcam_fixed_sideline_offset_height
 cl_tvcam_fixed_sideline_offset_top
 cl_tvcam_fixed_sideline_max_dist
 cl_tvcam_flyfollow_offset_height
 cl_tvcam_flyfollow_offset_distance
 cl_tvcam_flyfollow_offset_distance_top
 cl_tvcam_topdown_offset_height


These are early implementations, and likely the exact way in which the camera adjusts as you zoom in will improve over time. Feedback,of course, is welcomed.

notes.title: Spectator camera improvements. Minor client crash fix.
notes.content:
Added new spectator commands and convars:

cl_spec_cam_dist - The camera distance used in spectator mode only
cl_spec_cam_increase_dist - A command which will increase the distance by a given default interval (25). This is bound to mouse wheel down (on your mouse's scroll wheel).
cl_spec_cam_decrease_dist - A command which will decrease the distance by a given default interval (25). This is bound to mouse wheel up (on your mouse's scroll wheel).
cl_spec_cam_change_interval - The interval at which the camera distance is increased and decreased
cl_spec_cam_height - The camera height used in spectator mode only
cl_specspeed - The speed of camera movement whilst in free roam (client-side equivalent of sv_specspeed)


Fixed a client crash bug which commonly occurred upon connecting to a server.

notes.title: Minor client & server bug fixes
notes.content:
Bug fixes
• Fixed client issue whereby outfield player gloves were not persisting after a game restart
• Fixed a server crash where the server would crash during the start of a match period, such as the start of the second half, the start of extra time periods, and also match restarts.

Please note that server owners will need to force their servers to update. This patch is optional for the time being, and your server will still appear to players before you update.

Get in touch!
We will endeavour to fix further server crashes in the coming months, amongst other updates. Please ensure that if you feed back to us any server crashes that you encounter, and where possible, steps you believe may help us to reproduce the crashes.

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 2 September 2019
notes.content:
[GAMEPLAY]

- Reduced front standing reach
The egg shape will be kept, but the extra forward reach will be reduced from 30% to 20%.

- Slide tackles now slide longer, slower and you get up quicker.
Back to the March-April update but with more front slide reach

- Deflection radius reduced
Before 25 August 2019

- Ball near waist part will shoot instead of head

- Jumping increased

- Heading spin reduced

- Keeper reach increased on the opposite (feet)
This to decrease the chance of goals when keeper accidently dives away from the shots

- Injury time average has been reduced

[ASSETS]

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 26 August 2019
notes.content:
[GAMEPLAY]

 Slide tackle forward reach reduced. (55 to 45)
The front reach total length has been reduced.

 Deflection radius increased. (30 to 35)
Players reach to deflect a shot/cross/pass has increased. This should make it a bit more harder to shoot/cross/pass/head the ball around a player unless it's past the deflection radius.

 Stamina drains longer but replenish slower.
Your total stamina length has increased but it comes back slower than it used to be. This makes stamina management more of a factor.


[HUD]

 Added player text filter.
You can now filter player text above the player. In Customize > Visuals you have the option to see the names of only opponents, only teammates or both (default).


[ASSETS]

 Added 6v6_seven_mark_stadium made by what
 Added shoes made by what

Side and back standing reach have both been increased from 30 to 35 (front remains 45). This gives players now ~30% more reach forward than to the sides and the back (was 50% before).

[GAMEPLAY]


The player standing reach area is now egg-shaped instead of a box-shaped. This is similar to the circle area we had before, but gives players additional reach forward.

The player/ball collision area has been reduced. As a result the ball can be moved closer to the player's center before colliding with the player.

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 15 July 2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794956/98f2179fa5dcb4f288c7574362a64dc89531bdcc.jpg

Bugs

Fixed ball shadow bug when using low quality shadow setting.


Gameplay

Standing reach is now a box instead of circle, with more reach forward than to the sides and to the back. (see image)
A box should be easier to understand and play with rather than a circle.

Gravity reverted to 900

The shot mechanics have been slightly rebalanced. You can now look down and up 5° more to have more control. Other values have been adjusted accordingly.

Slide tackle now has a touch area that’s shifted further ahead but with less reach towards the back.

Deflection reach has been increased. This allows player the chance to deflect more shots/passes.


Keeper

Keeper changing direction limit is now 30° from the start angle.
This to prevent people from accidentally turning too much while diving and unintentionally reducing their own reach, while still allowing correction of dive direction after dive start.

Keeper diving speed has been slightly increased.
This to balance the fact that LMB/M1 and minimum RMB/M2 has been increased.

Keeper catch/parry timer has been decreased to 0.66s between shot and save (was 0.75).

Keeper parry the ball more forward.
This to prevent more shots going in while keeper parrys a shot. Will still happen if keeper angle isn’t ideal.


HUD

Added small bar at the bottom of the shot bar that shows you how much the vertical angle reduces the shot power.
The more you look up or down the weaker shots are. This is to allow you to dribble by looking down and to prevent people from shooting up straight in the air with full power. A full bar means you have the vertical angle where you can shoot with full power.

Shot bar and stamina bar are now symmetrical and expand from the center left and right (legacy bar style option is available in the customize menu)


Assets

Russia generic kit has been updated made by Lemon
All shoes made by Rawix has been updated and new ones added. Take a look!

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 23 June 2019
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32794956/57509f60203558e5ea522ed82cda5ec461f88493.png

Reworked the appearance customization menu
You can now set separate styles for keeper and outfield models and preview both at the same time. The base style settings have been merged into one drop-down menu to make it easier to cycle through all styles with the arrow keys.

Added more reach indicators
You can now see the reach you have when sliding and diving as keeper in addition to the regular standing reach. This option can be toggled on/off in "Customize -> Visuals -> Draw player reach indicators".

Removed the experimental radar
We heard your feedback and the majority of you prefer to not have a radar in the game for players on the field. It might come back as a horizontal version only for spectators in the future.
There have been suggestions for having a server toggle for the radar, but we want to ensure a consistent game experience across all matches and not leave it up to server admins whether the radar is visible for players or not.
We might experiment with other ways to indicate player positions in the future.

Balance changes

Adjusted the keeper catch mechanics so balls are more likely to be caught instead of punched away
Reduced the ball and foul reach for slide tackles
Adjusted the ball physics to let it roll a bit less
Increased the size of the ball for physics calculations

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 15 May 2019
notes.content:
[GAMEPLAY]


Ball reach reduced
- The ball ‘box’ has been slightly decreased to make the ball reach realistic with the texture.

Landing speed when jumping increased
- Now you won’t lose too much speed when you land after a jump.

Walking speed increased
- Ceremonial but still good to see a bit increased

Running speed decreased
- To create a decent gap between sprint and run speed. As increasing sprint speed wasn’t an option. This was a good alternative. After all it’s also the most realistic change.

Player accelerate decreased
- Another slight reduce in acceleration. So it will take a bit longer to get full speed.

Player bounding box increased
- From 20x20 to 22x22. This was 24x24 prior to the April update. 22x22 should be just enough to not go through players while keeping the boxes small as possible.

Slide tackle forward reach increased
- To make up for the lack of speed that it suffered month ago.

Slide tackle height reach increased
- Now more chance you can slide the ball more in the air than before

Keeper diving speed increased
- As we want to make the keeper realistic but also playable. It’s best to have a faster speed (as long it’s not ridiculous high) but less in total reach.

Keeper forward dive height reach increased
- Same as slide tackling but also for keeper forward dive

Keeper rebound power increased
- For making it harder to score ‘easy’ rebound goals

Keeper time parry timer increased
- More likely that a keeper parry shots. However keeper will always save standing saves and when the ball comes near the hands (sweetspot).

Volley now adds 10% more power and spin
- Get ready. You can only volley when ball is hip height and curling it.

All shots and headers can be performed on various angles
- For example headers are easier to control as they can come down more than before.

Deflections have more weight
- The ball will ‘fly’ less when you shoot on someone while he can’t control it.

Dribbling weight reduced
- Should make dribbling feel more responsive

Set-piece time limit increased
- Instead of 15 seconds, you now have 20 seconds time to shoot.

Set-piece system changed
- You can only run to the ball. If you failed to do so you will need to run back and wait till the block timer is off.

Set-piece shield increased
- Example for free-kicks the wall distance is bigger. This should give the free-kick taker a better chance to shoot over the wall.


[MISC]


8v8_wasser_stadium added
- Finally a new 8v8 stadium arrived! Thanks to @NIGHTFLAME

Ukraine generic kits added
- The yellow blue Ukrainian generic kit made by @nsq

cl_cam_height new default value is 0.
- It’s better for newer players to learn from the 0 height view. However this doesn’t any current players as their height value is already set in config.cfg.

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 22 July 2018

Gameplay

Reverted previous player/ball collision change:
Players unintendedly hit themselves with shots too often when the ball rolled into their model.
Fixed mass benching after half-time due to wrong AFK check.
Improved set piece shield behavior and drawing conditions.
Reduced set piece charged shot block activation time and increase linger time:
The intention behind this mechanism is to force players to perform the shot while moving during penalties to give keepers a fairer chance. If you stop at the ball for a bit you won't be able to perform a charged shot. You then need to move back and wait a bit until you can have another try.

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 21 July 2018
notes.content:
Gameplay

Removed curling from dribble shot:
This makes dribbling easier and more consistent.
Removed ball collisions while dribbling with the ball on the ground:
You can now weave the ball between your feet (Note: You will still hit yourself if you shoot while the ball is behind you).
Reduced collision distance between players:
You can now move closer to players before colliding with them.
Added player reach indicator:
The circle shows you the area where you can shoot the ball (can be toggled in the "Customize -> Visuals" menu).
Increased player deflection area:
Blocking crosses is now easier than before.
Added dynamic set-piece shield:
The set piece shield starts at radius 0 and grows over a couple of seconds to max radius. This gives players time to position themselves and allows faster set piece execution.
Removed charged shot from kick-offs:
You can only use dribble shot now to perform a kick-off. This is to combat cheap goals right after kick-off.
Adjusted player/ball collision area at the feet:
The ball bounces off at a better angle now when hitting another player in the feet.
Reduced keeper catch/parry timer:
Keepers catch more shots now instead of parrying them.
Reduced keeper punch strength:
Keepers have now more chance to reclaim rebounds than before.
Slightly increased header curl strength.
Changed default keeper mode to legacy settings:
A/D = Side dive and W/S = Jump. This can be changed in the "Customize -> Gameplay" menu.
Fixed a bug where step sounds would be played during instant replays.
Reduced the volume of other players' footsteps.
Added AFK auto-benching for players who aren't moving for too long:
Adjust with "sv_awaytime_match_autospec". Set to 0 to disable.
Added ConVars to control the random team kit pool servers select kits from in public matches:
"sv_randomteams_pool_default"
"sv_randomteams_pool_custom"
"sv_randomteams_pool_real_clubs"
"sv_randomteams_pool_real_national_teams"
"sv_randomteams_pool_fictitious_clubs"

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 20 June 2018
notes.content:
Removed versioning in default map names. (eg. 8v8_vienna_b6 becomes 8v8_vienna) This to prevent servers from not auto-starting when a map name changes because of an updated version while the old version (which would be the default one) gets removed.
Updated in-game languages for the following: Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Swedish.
NOTE: Brazilian-Portuguese is not supported in SDK 2007 and therefor it still will be English.
NOTE2: Not all languages are translated 100%. The remaining English texts will be translated in the near future.
Added and updated a lot of generic kits (Spain, Netherlands, Korea Republic and more!) made by Flame and tet  
Added a lot of generic shoes made by tet and Flame  
Added new 5v5 map `5v5_fast` made by Casana
Added a default 11v11 map to replace the current template map
New main menu sounds made by Hobomania 
Extra time and penalties are enabled in public mode
Disabled all talk during 8v8/4v4 competitive match
Reduced cool-down times from 30 to 15 seconds
Increased red card timer in 8v8 competitive from 18 to 22.5 in-game minutes
Made sv_lan 1 default in listenservers to avoid players joining tutorials
Changed hostname for listenserver from IOSoccer Listen Server to Personal Listen Server to make sure that it's not a regular IOS server
Slight reduce in ball spin
Increased distance between free-kick taker and opponent

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 10 June 2018
notes.content:
Added new map 8v8_court_hey by tet-
Improved keeper bots
Improved team kit color clash prevention
Added help texts to spectator menu
Spectator menu can now be toggled with skill key instead of slide key (CTRL by default)

notes.title: IOSoccer Update - 9 June 2018
notes.content:
Added Discord link to main menu
Added help text for join menu to spectator mode
Improved automatic team kit selection to prevent color clashes
